AGENDA
  CITY COUNCIL MEETING
  OCTOBER 4, 2022
UNTIL FURTHER NOTICE, MEETINGS WILL BE CONDUCTED PURSUANT TO THE PROVISIONS OF
ASSEMBLY BILL 361, WHICH ALLOWS COUNCIL MEMBERS TO PARTICIPATE FROM A REMOTE
LOCATION WITHOUT LISTING A PHYSICAL LOCATION. TO PROVIDE COMMENTS DURING A MEETING:
YOU MAY ATTEND THE MEETING, SEND AN EMAIL TO: publiccomments@norwalkca.gov, OR JOIN THE
ZOOM MEETING BY CALLING: (669) 900-6833 OR USING THE ZOOM APP WITH THE FOLLOWING LINK:
https://us02web.zoom.us/j/7095732685; MEETING ID: 709 573 2685. THE MEETING MAY BE VIEWED
THROUGH ZOOM, FIOS CHANNEL 32 OR CHARTER CHANNEL 3, OR ON THE CITY'S WEBPAGE AT:
https://www.norwalk.org/city-hall/meeting-agendas-393.
  6:00 PM
  NORWALK CITY HALL/COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  AND VIA VIDEOCONFERENCE

  Rick Ramirez, Mayor
  Ana Valencia, Vice Mayor
  Tony Ayala, Councilmember
  Jennifer Perez, Councilmember
  Margarita L. Rios, Councilmember
  Public Comment: Comments may be made in person, submitted via email at: publiccomments@norwalkca.gov, or through
  the video conference during the designated time on any item on the agenda or on any other matter within the jurisdiction
  subject to the rules of decorum described in Norwalk Municipal Code §2.08.020. The maximum time allowed is three
  minutes.

  Pursuant to provisions of the Brown Act, no action may be taken on a matter unless it is listed on the agenda, or unless
  certain emergency or special circumstances exist. The City Council may direct staff to investigate and/or schedule certain
  matters for consideration at a future City Council meeting.

  Please adhere to the following procedures when addressing the Council:

  • Comments should be limited to 3 minutes or less.
  • Comments should be directed to the City Council as a whole and not directed to individual Councilmembers.

  Americans with Disabilities Act: In compliance with the ADA, if you need special assistance to participate in a City
  meeting or other services offered by this City, please contact the City Clerk's Department, (562) 929-5720. Assisted listening
  devices are available at this meeting. Ask the City Clerk if you desire to use this device. Upon request, the agenda and
  documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability.
  Notification of at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist the City staff in assuring
  that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.

  Note: Any writings and/or documents provided to a majority of the City Council regarding any item on this agenda after it
  has been posted will also be made available for public inspection.

  Writings and/or documents are available for inspection in the City Clerk's Department, City Hall, 12700 Norwalk Boulevard
  during regular business hours, 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday - Thursday and 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., every other Friday;
  telephone (562) 929-5720. You may also contact the City Clerk via e mail at recordsrequests@norwalkca.gov.

  CLOSED SESSION MEETING – 5:00 p.m.
 CALL TO ORDER
  Mayor Ramirez

ROLL CALL
  Theresa Devoy, CMC
  City Clerk

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS FOR CLOSED SESSION MATTERS

CLOSED SESSION

  I.  CONFERENCE WITH REAL PROPERTY NEGOTIATOR PURSUANT TO GOVERNMENT CODE
  54956.8 – Property: Norwalk Entertainment Center, Assessor Parcel Nos. 8047-006-922, 8047-006-
  924, 8047-006-925; Negotiating Parties: Jesus M. Gomez, City Manager, on behalf of the City and
  Arturo Sneider, Primestor Development Inc.; Under Negotiation: Price and Terms of Payment.

  II.  CONFERENCE WITH REAL PROPERTY NEGOTIATOR PURSUANT TO GOVERNMENT CODE
  §54956.8: Property: Front Street properties, Assessor Property Numbers 8056-015-014 and 8056-025-
  020; Negotiating Parties: Jesus M. Gomez, City Manager, on behalf of the City and Arturo Sneider,
  Primestor Development Inc.; Under Negotiation: Price and Terms of Payment.

  III.  CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL – ANTICIPATED  LITIGATION  PURSUANT  TO
  GOVERNMENT CODE §54956.9(d)(4) in one case.

RECESS

REGULAR MEETING – 6:00 p.m.

CALL TO ORDER
  Mayor Ramirez

INVOCATION
  Pastor Ed Nelson
  New Branch Ministries

FLAG SALUTE
  Alexander Mejia
  Lakeland Elementary School

ROLL CALL
  Theresa Devoy, CMC
  City Clerk

CLOSED SESSION REPORT

CITY COUNCIL COMMENTS

  a.  Report of City Council Travel

SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS

  I.  City Council to recognize Norwalk Resident Julia Fonseca for being named 1st Runner-Up in the Miss
  Philippines USA Pageant.

  II.  United States Navy Birthday Cake Cutting Ceremony.

  III.  City Council to recognize Norwalk High School as the winners of the Norwalk Mayor’s Cup.

  IV.  City Council to Proclaim October as Breast Cancer Awareness Month in the City of Norwalk.

CITY MANAGER COMMENTS

  1.  COVID-19 Update.
   2.  City Council to recognize the Norwalk High School Football Team for winning the annual Mayor’s Cup
  game.

  3.  Mexican Independence Day 16th of September celebration highlights.

  4.  Mini Mr. Sun highlights.

  5.  Department Highlights.

  6.  Bi-Weekly Review.

CONSENT CALENDAR

Consent calendar items are considered routine matters which may be enacted by one motion and roll call vote.
Any item may be removed from the consent calendar and considered separately by City Council.

  1.  WAIVE READING IN FULL OF ALL ORDINANCES ON THE AGENDA - Staff recommends City Council
  waive reading in full of all ordinances on the agenda and declare that said titles which appear on the
  public agenda shall be determined to have been read by title and further reading waived.

  2.  MEETING MINUTES – Staff recommends City Council approve the minutes of the meetings of
  September 19 and 20, 2022. 825-04

  Minutes

  3.  PAYROLL – Staff recommends City Council approve the payroll for the period September 4, 2022 –
  September 17, 2022, in the total amount of $1,028,459.57. 630

  Report

  4.  COMMERCIAL DEMANDS – Staff recommends City Council approve the warrant register period
  September 10, 2022 – September 26, 2022 in the total amount of $1,802,868.65. 640

  Report

  5.  CLAIMS AGAINST THE CITY - Staff recommends City Council deny the claims filed by Dennis and
  Jennifer Schutt. 830-19

  Report

  6.  AGREEMENT WITH SUPERION, LLC TO PROVIDE WEB-BASED TIMECARD SOFTWARE –
  RESOLUTION NO. 22-54 – BUDGET AMENDMENT - Staff recommends City Council:

  a.  adopt Resolution No. 22-54, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  NORWALK AUTHORIZING AN AMENDMENT TO THE FISCAL YEAR 2022/23 ADOPTED
  BUDGET TO APPROPRIATE FUNDING FOR THE WEB-BASED TIMECARD SOFTWARE USING
  AMERICAN RESCUE PLAN ACT’S STATE AND LOCAL FISCAL RECOVERY FUNDS, in the
  amount of $12,300; and

  b.  approve a Sales Order pursuant to the existing agreement with Superion, LLC (dba Central
  Square); and authorize the City Manager to execute the Sales Order on behalf of the City, and any
  amendments provided there is funding in the budget, on behalf of the City, in a form approved by
  the City Attorney. 630

  Report

  7.  REQUEST FOR USE OF CIVIC CENTER LAWN FOR CARNIVAL - Staff recommends City Council
  approve the carnival requested by the Door of Hope of Norwalk for Monday, October 31 through
  Tuesday, November 8, 2022. 920-01-02

  Report

APPOINTMENTS
   8.  ADVISORY BODIES – Staff recommends City Council make appointments to fill the vacancies on the
  various City advisory bodies. 200

  Report

PUBLIC HEARING

  9.  NORWALK ENTERTAINMENT DISTRICT – CIVIC CENTER PROJECT - RESOLUTION NO. 22-55 -
  APPROVING GENERAL PLAN AMENDMENT NO. 184 AND ZONE CHANGE NO. 363; RESOLUTION
  NO. 22-56 - APPROVING CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT NO. 2022-01; RESOLUTION NO. 22-57,
  ADOPTING ENVIRONMENTAL FINDINGS PURSUANT TO CALIFORNIA ENVIRONMENTAL
  QUALITY ACT, CERTIFYING THE FINAL ENVIRONMENTAL IMPACT REPORT, APPROVING A
  MITIGATION MONITORING AND REPORTING PROGRAM, AND ADOPTING A STATEMENT OF
  OVERRIDING CONSIDERATIONS; ORDINANCE NO. 22-1733, APPROVING DEVELOPMENT
  AGREEMENT NO. 2022-01 BY AND BETWEEN THE CITY OF NORWALK AND PRIMESTOR
  DEVELOPMENT, INC.; AND ORDINANCE NO. 22-1734, ADOPTING ZONING TEXT AMENDMENT
  NO. 2022-01 ESTABLISHING THE NORWALK ENTERTAINMENT DISTRICT – CIVIC CENTER
  SPECIFIC PLAN – Staff recommends City Council:

  a.  adopt Resolution No. 22-55, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  NORWALK APPROVING GENERAL PLAN AMENDMENT NO. 184 AND ZONE CHANGE NO.
  363;

  b.  adopt RESOLUTION NO. 22-56, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  NORWALK APPROVING CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT NO. 2022-01;

  c.  adopt RESOLUTION NO. 22-57, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  NORWALK ADOPTING ENVIRONMENTAL FINDINGS PURSUANT TO THE CALIFORNIA
  ENVIRONMENTAL QUALITY ACT, CERTIFYING THE FINAL ENVIRONMENTAL IMPACT
  REPORT FOR THE NORWALK ENTERTAINMENT DISTRICT – CIVIC CENTER SPECIFIC PLAN
  (SCH #2022020128), APPROVING A MITIGATION MONITORING AND REPORTING PROGRAM,
  AND ADOPTING A STATEMENT OF OVERRIDING CONSIDERATIONS;

  d.  introduce by title only ORDINANCE NO. 22-1735, AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY OF NORWALK,
  CALIFORNIA APPROVING DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT NO. 2022-01 BY AND BETWEEN
  THE CITY OF NORWALK AND PRIMESTOR DEVELOPMENT, INC., and schedule for adoption;
  and

  e.  introduce by title only ORDINANCE NO. 22-1734, AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY OF NORWALK
  ADOPTING ZONING TEXT AMENDMENT NO. 2022-01 ESTABLISHING THE NORWALK
  ENTERTAINMENT DISTRICT - CIVIC CENTER SPECIFIC PLAN, and schedule for adoption.
  1405-07

  Report

ORDINANCE

  10. ORDINANCE NO. 22-1733 - PROHIBITING SMOKING AT MULTI-UNIT RENTAL DWELLINGS - Staff
  recommends City Council introduce by title only Ordinance No. 22-1733, AN ORDINANCE OF THE
  CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF NORWALK ADDING CHAPTER 8.60 TO TITLE 8 OF THE
  NORWALK MUNICIPAL CODE TO PROHIBIT SMOKING IN MULTI-UNIT RENTAL DWELLINGS, and
  schedule for adoption.

  Report

REPORTS

  11. RESOLUTION NO. 22-58 - APPROVE A GROUND LEASE AGREEMENT FOR THE NORWALK
  ENTERTAINMENT DISTRICT - CIVIC CENTER PROJECT -Staff recommends City Council:

  a.  adopt Resolution No. 22-58, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  NORWALK APPROVING A GROUND LEASE BY AND BETWEEN THE CITY OF NORWALK AND
  PRIMESTOR DEVELOPMENT INC.; and
   b.  authorize the City Manager to execute the agreement, any documents required under the terms of
  the Ground Lease and such other ancillary documents, and any additional amendments provided
  there is funding in the budget, in a form authorized by the City Attorney. 1405-07

  Report

  12. APPROVAL OF OPTION AGREEMENTS FOR THE DEVELOPMENT OF A MIXED-USE PROJECT
  WITHING THE HEART OF NORWALK PROJECT AREA - Staff recommends City Council approve:

  a.  Option Agreement No. 1 for Assessor Parcel numbers 8056-015-004, and -006,

  b.  Option Agreement No. 2 for Assessor Parcel No. 8056-015-007, and

  c.  authorize the City Manager to execute the agreements and amendments provided there is funding
  in the budget, on behalf of the City, in forms approved by the City Attorney. 1407-08

  Report

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS

ADJOURNMENT

I hereby certify under penalty of perjury under the laws of the State of California that the foregoing agenda was posted
on the City Hall bulletin board not less than 72 hours prior to the meeting. Dated September 30, 2022.

Theresa Devoy, CMC
City Clerk
